6. RISK MITIGATION & PRODUCTION FAIL-SAFE
To eliminate client PC freeze or crash risks, AeroGuard AI implements a dual safety layer:
•
Remote Kill-Switch: Reads a local network `security_policy.json` file every 5 minutes. IT administrators can toggle off
features instantly across all 5,000 PCs without requiring a system reboot.
•
Graceful Degradation: If typing biometric analysis fails, the system isolates the module and defaults to active screen
watermarking without bringing down the OS.
